name: Stage 14: Djupviksängen to Fredriksberg, väg 223
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 14, Djupviksängen to Fredriksberg, väg 223.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Djupviksängen is the official start but has no parking at the etappstart. Use connector planning, bus context, or the Björndalsbergen/Gullsmedsmoravägen access instead.

Fredriksberg/road 223 has only limited roadside parking for a few cars where the trail crosses the road. The old Fredriksberg bus stop is no longer a dependable stop; use nearby Svinsjö gård/Adolfsberg context and live-check rural departures.

No verified toilet, shop, or wind shelter was found directly on stage 14. The only stage water is the Lövviken natural spring; nearby bus stops such as Alsjötorp, Lilla Hammarbosäter, Svinsjö gård, and Adolfsberg need live timetable checks before relying on them.
Björndalsbergen/Gullsmedsmora parking is the best reserve/loop access; the loop road crossing may fit only a single car and should not be treated as primary parking.
waterSources: The official spring shortly after the road to Lövviken is the only explicit stage water source. OSM maps the same source as Källa/drinking_water, and 2016/2024 hiker reports found good/cold/fresh water, but Sörmlandsleden source quality is not routinely guaranteed; treat/filter unless current quality is verified.
Glådran and Klämmingen are natural lake water only and should not be treated as potable refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6.5 km; Naturkartan and OSM relation 3808981 agree, while measured geometry and GPS/app traces are around 6.3-6.6 km. Older 8 km references appear stale and should not override the current official length.

Short but fairly demanding stage: steep climb from Djupviksängen up Lövviksbergen, views over Klämmingen, then hällmark and forest toward Ulvsättersbergen and Glådran. AllTrails-style elevation figures around 224-228 m ascent are plausible for difficulty context.

Active official warning dated 2025-11-14: forestry work on the northern part from Glådran to road 223 has left timber piles across the trail, muddy machine ruts/ditches, difficult passage, and markings that may need review after felling. Treat this as a live safety caveat until the official page removes it.

The Björndalsbergen/Glådran loop is a useful related option: official loop is 3.5 km, starts at the Björndalsbergen access, and adds about 1 km if used instead of the direct main-route line. In the route builder, present it as a selectable alternate between the south split near 59.168746, 17.215879 and the rejoin near 59.173224, 17.215308, not as an independent through-stage.

For geometry, OSM relation 3808981 is the correct Stage 14 relation but is stored mostly north-to-south; reverse/order it for the official Djupviksängen-to-Fredriksberg direction. The measured relation is about 6.36 km, compatible with the official 6.5 km.

Glådran is the best verified overnight/rest area on the stage, with official tenting guidance and confirmed north/south fireplaces. Southwest Glådran is officially preferred for tents, but 2024 reports note limited truly flat ground; northeast also works and has a table/simple fireplace context. Use prepared fire sites only and check current fire bans.

Björndalsbergen reserve rules prohibit damaging living/dead trees and collecting protected plants/fungi; berries, edible mushrooms, and flowers for personal use are allowed. Bring your own fuel rather than collecting reserve wood, and get permission for organized camps/competitions.
Use leash/close-control as the practical dog default in the reserve and around wildlife, especially during the national 1 March-20 August sensitive period.
Do not imply free fishing at Glådran or Klämmingen. Gnesta fishing-card rules apply to Klämmingen/Frösjön and related waters, while Glådran-specific public fishing permission was not verified.
Rural bus service around Laxne, Lilla Hammarbosäter, Svinsjö gård, and Adolfsberg is sparse and pattern-dependent; show these as access context, not guaranteed trailhead service.

facilities.name: Djupviksängen start / no parking
facilities.description: Official stage start. Sörmlandsleden explicitly says there is no parking at the etappstart.

facilities.name: Alsjötorp bus context
facilities.description: Closest practical bus context on the Djupviksängen side, about 1.6 km straight-line. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Djupviksängen start-area picnic
facilities.description: OSM picnic/rest node near the early trail.

facilities.name: Lövviksberget climb/view
facilities.description: Terrain/view context for the steep initial climb above Klämmingen.

facilities.name: Lövviken route point
facilities.description: Former ironworks/cultural landscape context noted by Sörmlandsleden.

facilities.name: Björndalsbergen loop option
facilities.description: Official loop/access point at Lövviken/Lövviksvägen. The full loop is 3.5 km including the shared stem; the alternate through Björndalsbergen adds roughly 1 km to Stage 14 if chosen.

facilities.name: Björndalsbergen alternate south split
facilities.description: Exact OSM split where the optional Björndalsbergen/Glådran alternate diverges from the direct Stage 14 line. The direct split-to-rejoin segment is about 0.8 km; the alternate is about 1.7 km.

facilities.name: Björndalsbergen alternate rejoin
facilities.description: Exact OSM rejoin where the optional Björndalsbergen/Glådran alternate reconnects with Stage 14 near Glådran. Use this as the route-builder variant rejoin, not the full loop as a through-stage.

facilities.name: Björndalsbergen/Gullsmedsmoravägen parking
facilities.description: Reserve/access parking, more appropriate than trying to park at Djupviksängen or squeezing in at road crossings. Länsstyrelsen describes access by following Klämmingen to the parking area.

facilities.name: Björndalsbergen reserve rules
facilities.description: Do not damage living/dead wood or protected plants/fungi. Organized camps/competitions require permission; use prepared fire sites only and bring fuel rather than collecting reserve wood.

facilities.name: Lilla Hammarbosäter bus context
facilities.description: Sparse rural bus context about 1.5 km west of Björndalsbergen reserve access; live-check departures.

facilities.name: Laxne bus context
facilities.description: Bus/access context for the broader Laxne/Björndalsbergen area, not directly at the stage start; live-check rural service.

facilities.name: Lövviken spring / Källa
facilities.description: Official natural spring after the road to Lövviken, about 2.5 km in. OSM maps Källa/drinking_water at nearly the same point, and 2016/2024 hikers found good/fresh flow; still treat/filter unless current quality is verified.

facilities.name: Glådran lake water
facilities.description: Humus-brown lake water and rest context only; filter/boil/treat if used.

facilities.name: Södra Glådran fire/camp
facilities.description: South/southwest Glådran is the officially preferred tent side, with nearby firepit context. Recent reports note limited truly flat ground; use prepared fire site only and check fire bans.

facilities.name: Södra Glådran fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped south/southwest firepit at the Glådran rest area. Gnesta and local reports indicate two prepared grill places around Glådran; exact field placement should still be checked. Bring fuel where allowed and check current fire bans.

facilities.name: Norra Glådran tent/rest
facilities.description: Northeast Glådran is also usable for tents according to official guidance; OSM maps a backcountry campsite here.

facilities.name: Norra Glådran fireplace/rest area
facilities.description: North-side picnic/rest area with table and simple fireplace, matching Sörmlandsleden loop text and OSM fireplace=yes mapping. Check fire bans and bring fuel.

facilities.name: Glådran/Klämmingen fishing rights warning
facilities.description: Do not assume free fishing. Gnesta fishing-card rules apply to Klämmingen/Frösjön and related waters, while Glådran-specific public fishing permission was not verified.

facilities.name: Dog control in Björndalsbergen
facilities.description: No special dog rule was found for Björndalsbergen, but Swedish 1 Mar-20 Aug wildlife rules require extra control; leash is the practical default in the reserve and around wildlife.

facilities.name: Forestry warning: Glådran to road 223
facilities.description: Official 2025-11-14 report: ongoing forestry north of Glådran left timber piles across the trail, muddy/rutted machine tracks and ditches, difficult passage, and markings that may need review. Treat as live until removed from the official page.

facilities.name: Fredriksberg road 223 limited roadside parking
facilities.description: Limited roadside/lay-by parking for a few cars where the trail crosses road 223; not a formal trailhead car park. The old Fredriksberg bus stop has been removed.

facilities.name: Fredriksberg info board
facilities.description: Information/map node at the stage end.

facilities.name: Svinsjö gård bus context
facilities.description: Closest useful bus-stop context to the Fredriksberg end, about 0.5 km south. Fredriksberg stop has been removed; check live rural service.

facilities.name: Adolfsberg/Marietorp bus context
facilities.description: Additional nearby bus context north/east of the Fredriksberg end; check live rural service.

facilities.name: No toilet or shelter on Stage 14
facilities.description: Official/Naturkartan/OSM checks found no toilet or wind shelter on this stage. Do not infer Stage 15 shelters backward onto Stage 14.
